title: SectorScope
description: NIS2-sourced archetype — sector and subsector classification under Directive (EU) 2022/2555. Determines which NIS2 sector an entity belongs to and its criticality level. Rootless — regulatory scoping dimension. Source: NIS2 Annexes I (high-criticality) and II (other critical sectors).

sector.description: NIS2 sector. ENERGY through SPACE: Annex I (high-criticality sectors). POSTAL_AND_COURIER through RESEARCH: Annex II (other critical sectors). Source: NIS2 Annex I, Annex II.

subsector.description: NIS2 subsector within the sector (e.g., ENERGY → electricity, oil, gas, hydrogen, district heating/cooling). Free text — subsector granularity varies by sector per Annexes I/II.

annexReference.description: Which NIS2 annex classifies this sector. ANNEX_I: sectors of high criticality. ANNEX_II: other critical sectors. Determines baseline obligation level.
